messages:
Maya: Quick sync — putting together a concise playbook for the beta cohort handoff. Proposed structure: 8-week beta, target 10 partners, two engagement tiers (high-touch weekly, low-touch biweekly async). Need alignment on: success metrics, what we commit as latency/cost SLOs for partners, fallback behavior for quality/regression, and recruitment/incentive rules. Thoughts?

Alex: Sounds good. For SLOs during beta we should avoid hard promises for large open models. Proposal: commit to p50 < 300ms and p99 < 2s for smaller/optimized models; for heavy models say best-effort with documented fallback. Must include automatic fallback policy for spikes.

Samir: From design side: we need clear 'quality drop' thresholds. Suggest: >10% relative drop on automated metrics (BLEU/ROUGE/Embed-sim) or >15% drop on user-rated accuracy = trigger. Also we should define a canonical prompt set for continuous eval and put sample prompts in the playbook.

Jess: Recruitment notes: target companies with internal ML/platform teams and clear product owners. Incentives: 3 months of free dedicated capacity or credits + prioritized support and a kickoff workshop. Create onboarding checklist (API keys, test corpus, RBAC, contact points).

Eric: CS perspective: weekly showbacks for high-touch and biweekly for low-touch. Need an escalation matrix tied to the SLA: who owns infra, model tuning, pricing negotiations. I'll draft a RACI and include a contact list.

beta-bot: :rotating_light: Reminder: cohort seats left: 12. Auto-enroll closes in 4d.

Maya: Quick operational asks: 1) Can Eng produce an automated fallback policy we can surface to partners by EOD Fri? 2) Can we get draft SLO wording suitable for legal review? Alex, Samir, Eric — owners?

Alex: Yes — I'll sketch a fallback runbook. Rough policy: prefer quantized variant on latency spike, else route to smaller model; degrade streaming to buffered mode if token generation latencies spike. ETA: Fri EOD.

Samir: I'll assemble the canonical prompt set and mock dashboards (quality/regression + engagement metrics) by Tue. Will include example alert thresholds.

Jess: I'll start the initial outreach list and draft the incentive email + signup form. Happy to take leads if you DM me names of potential partners.

Eric: Drafting the RACI + incident play specifically for beta flows (who paged for perf regressions, who owns customer comms). Will include escalation SLAs and contact hunt.

Alex: Quick code snippet for fallback rule we can include in the runbook:

```\nif latency > 2000ms or error_rate > 1%:\n    route_to_fallback_model()\nelif p50 > 300ms:\n    switch_to_quantized_variant()\n```

Samir: Also propose we capture qualitative feedback via a one-question NPS-style pulse after each major milestone and a longer product survey at week 4. Keep feedback short to maximize response.

Maya: Nice — summary / next steps: I'll consolidate a short PRD and send to execs Mon morning. Owners on the doc: Eng=Alex, Design=Samir, Solutions=Jess, CS=Eric. Deliverables & ETA: fallback runbook (Alex) Fri EOD, prompt set + dashboards (Samir) Tue, outreach + incentives (Jess) ongoing, RACI + incident play (Eric) Tue. I'll combine in one playbook and share draft with the partners list before EOW. :thumbsup:

Alex: Ack.

Jess: Ack — will DM high-touch candidate list.

Eric: Ack — adding escalation emails to pager list.

Maya: Thanks all — will post the consolidated doc in #product and attach the onboarding checklist. Ping me if anything slips.
